title: "Analyzing US Census Data"
author: Trinity Harden
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| fig-height: 10
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
income_tx |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = estimate)) +
  geom_sf(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "viridis",
    labels = scales::label_dollar(),
    name = "Median household income"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by Texas County",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates (B19013_001)."
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "gray40", hjust = 0),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(
    total = "B15003_001",
    bachelors = "B15003_022",
    masters = "B15003_023",
    professional = "B15003_024",
    doctorate = "B15003_025"
  ),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 12
edu_state |>
  filter(variable %in% c(
    "bachelors",
    "masters",
    "professional",
    "doctorate"
  )) |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarise(
    bachelor_plus_pct = sum(estimate, na.rm = TRUE) / first(summary_est) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = bachelor_plus_pct,
    y = fct_reorder(NAME, bachelor_plus_pct)
  )) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Adults 25+ with a Bachelor's Degree or Higher by State",
    x = "Share of adults age 25+ with a bachelor's degree or higher",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates (Table B15003)."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 8)),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "gray20", size = 8),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "gray40", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 10))
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
age_ca <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = c(
    median_age = "B01002_001",
    population = "B01003_001"
  ),
  state = "CA",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
age_ca_wide <- age_ca |>
  select(NAME, variable, estimate) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate)

ggplot(age_ca_wide, aes(x = population, y = median_age)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.75, size = 2) +
  geom_text(
    data = age_ca_wide |>
      slice_max(population, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) |>
      arrange(desc(population)) |>
      mutate(label_y = median_age + c(3, -1, 4, -3, 3)),
    aes(y = label_y, label = stringr::str_remove(NAME, ", California")),
    hjust = 1.1,
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 3,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "Population and Median Age Across California Counties",
    x = "County population (log scale)",
    y = "Median age (years)",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 8)),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "gray40", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 10))
  )
```
